# [](https://act.electjon.com/go/4629?t=1&akid=2888%2E5691347%2E1PhnYt)

Remember, Peter, Trump promised to lower prices on day one...
Instead, the broken old man just threw a two-day party in Texas, while it costs more than ever to fill up your truck, to stock your fridge, and to power your home.
Under the failed President Donald J. Trump, food, diesel, and health care all just hit their all-time highs.
All while the crook president and his crook family raked in billions from all over the world.
Half a billion from the Emirati spy chief to the Trump family crypto business, months before the administration granted the Emirates access to our most sensitive AI chips.
$1.6 billion of your money backing the Trump boys' mining interests in Kazakhstan. Jared Kushner on the Saudi payroll while he pretends to lead our Middle East diplomacy. And on and on.
See, while the world burns, and you pay more for everything, your tax dollars become the royal family’s wealth.
Because it pays to be a Trump, especially when the whole world knows daddy's a crook.
The only way we can put a stop to this endless cycle of corruption and self-enrichment is by regaining Congressional power.
Really.
This upcoming election is our last chance to restore checks and balances. Because if we don’t win this year, I don’t know if we'll make it to 2028.
And this Senate race is the most crucial in the country.
[**So don’t wait. Fellow Conservative: You won't find "RINO" in the dictionary. If we wrote the entry ourselves, it would read something like this:
**RINO** , n. /Rye-No/: _A career politician who runs as a "Republican" but cuts deals with Democrats, abandons conservative principles the moment it's convenient, and won't work more than 2.5 days a week to fight for the country._

That's not a joke. That describes far too many Republicans right now.
Case in point: the SAVE America Act. It simply requires people to prove they're citizens before they vote. It's supported by 80% of Americans. President Trump has championed it. The House has passed it multiple times. One version even got 50 votes in the Senate.
Democrats are fighting it tooth-and-nail — no surprise there. But Senate Republicans have the votes to pass it anyway. Asked why it's stalled, Majority Leader John Thune said plainly: "It's about the votes. It's about the math."
Let's check his math. Republicans ...
✅ Control the House, 218–215.
✅ Control the Senate, 53–47.
✅ Control the White House, 312 electoral votes to 226.
That's not an excuse. That's a mandate. And Senate leadership has every tool it needs to pass it — a talking filibuster, attaching it to a must-pass bill, or by eliminating the filibuster — they just won't.

**This is exactly why "NO RINOS! NO EXCUSES!" has to be our rally cry heading into Election Day.**

Democrats are fighting it tooth-and-nail — no surprise there. But Senate Republicans have the votes to pass it anyway. Asked why it's stalled, Majority Leader John Thune said plainly: "It's about the votes. It's about the math." Let's check his math. Republicans ... ✅ Control the House, 218–215. ✅ Control the Senate, 53–47. ✅ Control the White House, 312 electoral votes to 226. That's not an excuse. That's a mandate. And Senate leadership has every tool it needs to pass it — a talking filibuster, attaching it to a must-pass bill, or by eliminating the filibuster — they just won't. This is exactly why "NO RINOS! NO EXCUSES!" has to be our rally cry heading into Election Day. It's not enough to elect "politicians" just because they have an R next to their name. We need TRUE conservatives — proven fighters who won't fold the second it gets hard. That's why we are backing this group of candidates in the 2026 midterm elections: ▶ Ken Paxton (TX) ▶ Mike Collins (GA) ▶ Roger Marshall (KS) ▶ Ashley Moody (FL) ▶ Kevin Hern (OK) ▶ Harriet Hageman (WY) ▶ Bill Hagerty (TN) ▶ Barry Moore (AL) These candidates have earned SCF's endorsement because they'll fight for election integrity, secure the border, and hold the line on spending — even when it means taking on their own party's leadership. The DC establishment favors moderate Republicans, so it's up to us — the grassroots — to make sure conservatives have the funds they need to win. Any amount will help, but if you give $100 or more, one of our top supporters — Mike Rydin from Houston — has agreed to donate $100 to multiply your contribution. This is the perfect time to help elect strong conservative leaders and achieve the maximum impact. Peter, let’s bring you up to speed on what’s happening in the Tar Heel State.
Republicans have gone scorched-earth in their efforts to salvage the midterms. Their methods have ranged from rushing through a Trump-ordered racial gerrymander to trying to change vote-by-mail rules just _hours_ before ballots were mailed.
**It’s clear: The GOP will stop at nothing to hold on to power — even if it means undermining our democracy.**

name: Dan Cox
subject: Feel the Momentum!
body:
Maryland is ready for change to bring back common sense. | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/6ef90e315bec/feel-the-momentum?e=5bb5efcda7)
---
| |
---
| |
# Momentum to victory.
Dear friend,
Today, my wife shared a video of the first day of soccer for our special needs son that moved my heart.
[](https://us.list-manage.com/19wTApdauBV?e=5bb5efcda7&c2id=56a77d5a7be3731f6f21d9e4cc6a323b)
I was traversing the state's I-95 "blue" corridor with your next Lt. Governor Rob Krop, fighting for you.

And I was thinking of our son's future as well.

[](https://us.list-manage.com/HHfg8IK3NcR?e=5bb5efcda7&c2id=56a77d5a7be3731f6f21d9e4cc6a323b)

The momentum we see is strong and growing every day. Like today, when I was again approached spontaneously by Marylanders, including several minorities, young business leaders and managers of six stores, and several retirees - all of whom said in the public setting at the store that they support me and are voting for me because "you must win so we can actually stay here in Maryland, it's getting to be outrageously expensive." This organic support and momentum is real and far stronger than ever before, with a sense of urgency.

One man told me today his 2002 dump truck registration payment today was $1,100.00!!! And then a tire "fee" of $5 a tire on top of inflation and the 6% sales tax. Another business owner told me their electric bill is approaching $50,000!!! Unsustainable. And it is because of Wes Moore's policy decisions such as increasing 338 fees and taxes, closing power plants and having no care to ensure Maryland prospers.

It's so bad, friend, that Wes Moore is planning new taxes next year if he wins re-election. Today, he took credit for balancing the budget while blaming federal authorities for the fact that he has run our state's budget into the ground - and our economy to be the second worst economy in the nation. He blames others, yet our state's huge deficit was first announced under his first year of leadership when President Biden was in office back in 2023-24; his budget director ended up leaving. It was reported then that he had spent Governor Hogan's $5 Billion surplus cash on hand, and had continued to spend and waste taxpayer dollars into the $400 million and then $1 billion range. Now it is approaching $3.3 billion in a structural deficit!

We will right the ship and get Maryland back on track as the great state it is, with lower taxes, cutting fees, suspending the gas tax, bringing power plants online, fiscal responsibility and putting senior citizens first with 100% tax relief on property and pensions/retirement. No senior citizen or retiree should pay tax on Social Security but in Wes Moore's Maryland they must. Yet, no State anywhere near Maryland requires this \- not even the District of Columbia, Washington D.C.

You know we have gone astray by Wes Moore's leadership when we tax seniors worse than California, New York and Massachusetts combined. A Maryland senior living on IRA retirement income can face a substantially higher state-and-local income-tax bill than an identical retiree in California, New York, or Massachusetts, largely because Maryland taxes IRA withdrawals without its pension exclusion and adds county income tax on top of state income tax, plus taxes Social Security which those states do not do!

It's past time for change to renew Maryland. We need your support to run our cable TV ads, streaming TV ads and place our billboards. [Will you chip in today and donate what you can? Now is the moment - next week mail-in and ballot drop off voting begins](https://us.list-manage.com/150sU9J_mX1?e=5bb5efcda7&c2id=56a77d5a7be3731f6f21d9e4cc6a323b).

Thank you.

For Maryland,
Dan Cox
Governor nominee

P.S. We are close to launching new TV ads for our campaign - please donate now to help us get those running!

Authority: Dan Cox for Governor; Nick Krop, CPA, Treasurer.

Patriot,

There's now a law in California with my name associated with it. Everyone in Sacramento knows exactly what the "Stop Nick Shirley Act" means.

On August 22nd, Governor Newsom signed AB 2624. Three days later, I was standing at the State Capitol with a crowd of people who showed up because they understood what this law actually does.

https://click.parlermailer.com/?qs=ABB7InYiOjEsImQiOjUwMDN9AAwAAAAAAwTs_s85_2uFJNsessCmZjX5xThxbAoOyjcsV3qsyXdajeuKpDTj1oxT-FfbTX8c8CydvqErnEKZBatdq-UUqmD9wlOcE9PPCtyOo42iPA

Supporters say it protects immigration workers from harassment. Here's what it really does, Patriot: it makes it harder for anyone — me included — to investigate where your tax dollars are being sent.

I said it plainly at the rally: this is not the end; this is just the beginning.

Because here's the part that should bother you more than anything else. The assemblymember who wrote this bill is married to California's Attorney General— the one person in this state whose entire job is supposed to be going after fraud. Instead, his wife wrote the bill that makes it harder to expose it.

That's not a coincidence, Patriot. That's the system protecting itself.

https://click.parlermailer.com/?qs=ABB7InYiOjEsImQiOjUwMDN9AAwAAAAAAwTs_s86W1InX4k4G5ZQWWzBDoe6gK1irXX0wjciXww-BdLQSkBClwLfwJE7Rwvh2Gs524Z5hLyJjdID_uCuX5q_xytruPa3k2IwL5g5gA
Patriot, will you make a tax-deductible gift of $25, $50, or $100 today to help keep independent journalists like me in the field?

https://click.parlermailer.com/?qs=ABB7InYiOjEsImQiOjUwMDN9AAwAAAAAAwTs_s87B7GEHE-Oh7kxEneyMthI8kNUu8gEIvi604Yl39lRpnWi0KaRytVXL9lgkEvF-tyJiwoWf1ddjIvIYDwXPgWPo_hCZyzoKw0pvQ
Yes — I'll Help Keep Independent Journalists in the Field

I've spent the last year showing up where legacy media won't — daycare centers, tax-funded nonprofits, the offices of people who'd rather I disappear than answer a question. That work is exactly why a state legislature decided to write a law with my name on it instead of going after the fraud I keep finding.

Please remind your friends to vote: today is the first day of early voting in Virginia.
Recommended Votes:
-Re-elect John McGuire to Congress
-Bert Mizusawa US Senate
Since January 2025, my team and I have helped negotiate roughly $20 billion in investment into Virginia's Fifth District, creating about 7,000 well-paying jobs. My team and I have returned over $10 million owed by the federal government directly back to the people it belonged to. We passed the Wintergreen Emergency Egress Act, a bill that six previous 5th District congressmen failed to move through a subcommittee for over 25 years. It is now in the Senate, where it passed the full committee unanimously. And I was proud to spearhead the effort, working with Acting Secretary of the Navy Hung Cao, to finally deliver a Navy and Marine Corps ROTC program at Liberty University starting this year, something the university has pursued since 1971.
We also worked personally with Secretary of State Marco Rubio and Secretary of Defense Pete Hegseth to help get 57 of our constituents home from Israel when ballistic missiles were raining down across the country.
Two hundred fifty years ago, our Founding Fathers built this country on the Bible, and we are fighting to keep that foundation strong. House Republicans have worked with President Trump to strengthen our economy, support American workers, secure our border, rebuild the military, and unleash American energy. | Proud to earn the endorsement on my birthday of the National Federation of Independent Business, the nation's leading voice for small business.
As a 28-year small business owner, I know what it takes to make payroll, deal with regulations, and keep the lights on. That's why I fight every day in Congress to cut red tape, keep energy costs down, and give Main Street the certainty it needs to grow.
My opponent has a very different record. Tom Perriello not only voted for the 2009 cap-and-trade "climate change" bill that would have driven up energy prices on Virginia manufacturers, farmers, and small business owners, he proudly defended that vote. That same big-government climate approach later became the model for the Green New Deal: higher costs and more control from Washington. He also voted for Obamacare "the unaffordable care act" and has repeatedly said he has no regrets, even though it cost him his seat. For many small businesses, that law brought higher health insurance costs and new mandates. Healthcare premiums and deductibles for individuals also continue to rise significantly every year since. He backed the 2009 stimulus that added hundreds of billions in new debt while our district continued to struggle with jobs, and he voted with Nancy Pelosi roughly 90% of the time on the major economic bills of that Congress.
I have a 100% voting record with NFIB because I believe small businesses should keep more of what they earn and compete without Washington stacking the deck against them.
Virginia's small businesses deserve a partner in Congress who has actually lived their challenges, not another politician who keeps voting for more regulations and higher costs. We can't afford Tom Perriello.
Say no thank you, join the team, and vote John McGuire.

clean_body: | | | | == | Early Voting Starts Today | | Please remind your friends to vote: today is the first day of early voting in Virginia. Recommended Votes: -Re-elect John McGuire to Congress -Bert Mizusawa US Senate Since January 2025, my team and I have helped negotiate roughly $20 billion in investment into Virginia's Fifth District, creating about 7,000 well-paying jobs. My team and I have returned over $10 million owed by the federal government directly back to the people it belonged to. We passed the Wintergreen Emergency Egress Act, a bill that six previous 5th District congressmen failed to move through a subcommittee for over 25 years. It is now in the Senate, where it passed the full committee unanimously. And I was proud to spearhead the effort, working with Acting Secretary of the Navy Hung Cao, to finally deliver a Navy and Marine Corps ROTC program at Liberty University starting this year, something the university has pursued since 1971. We also worked personally with Secretary of State Marco Rubio and Secretary of Defense Pete Hegseth to help get 57 of our constituents home from Israel when ballistic missiles were raining down across the country. Two hundred fifty years ago, our Founding Fathers built this country on the Bible, and we are fighting to keep that foundation strong. House Republicans have worked with President Trump to strengthen our economy, support American workers, secure our border, rebuild the military, and unleash American energy. We are building 10 miles of wall per day. We delivered the largest investment in rural hospitals by far, $50 billion. We passed the Working Families Tax Cuts (the One Big Beautiful Bill), delivering No Tax on Tips, No Tax on Overtime, and historic tax relief for seniors with a $6,000 deduction. The Patriot Industries CEO in Louisa County told Kelly Loufler and me that no tax on overtime is clearly working because he sees higher-quality employee cars in the parking lot. And my wife Tracy loves it that we are at a roughly 125-year low in the murder rate across our country. If Democrats win, they will undo all of that. My fellow Virginians, early voting starts today. My opponent touts his woke carbon-credit climate-change agenda, has ties to George Soros-funded open-border policies, and brags about being the deciding vote in the House for Obamacare, the terrible, unaffordable care act. I need you to vote. So mark your calendars. Vote Republican up and down the ballot and let's keep America winning. And if you want a yard sign, want to volunteer, or want to donate, go to mcguireva.com. Thank you, God bless you, and God bless the United States of America! Here is news and some of what we have been up to: How to Lower Fuel Costs | | FYI: The United States is producing more crude oil than ever (record levels in 2025 and expected again in 2026), but refining capacity has declined due to recent plant closures and decades of regulatory barriers by Green New Deal (SCAM) type policies that have prevented construction of major new refineries. I sent a letter to President Trump asking him to consider a state of emergency and to significantly streamline the NEPA permitting process so we can build and expand domestic refining capacity faster. Without adequate refining capacity, even tripling our crude production wouldn't mean lower diesel, gasoline, and other fuel prices for American consumers. | A Heartbreaking Day | | | Tuesday September 16, was a tough, heartbreaking day. My best friend and childhood friend since middle school, George Vassey, lost his fight with cancer. This reality stings like nothing else and is a reminder, make sure we hug our loved ones. Every day is a gift, but not a guarantee. We went through so much together in high school. We were in the Sea Cadets, took karate taught by a Vietnam Green Beret, and shared a love of motorcycles, motorcycle racing, and an interest in serving our country in the military. We famously rode our bicycles from Richmond, Virginia to West Virginia and back. In our spare time we played paintball in the woods with a bunch of Vietnam veterans as part of our preparation to one day serve our country in the US military. In High School, George's mom would make us sloppy Joes while we took turns reading different Psalms. After graduation, I went on to become a Navy SEAL while George became a Navy Corpsman assigned to Marine recon teams. George is survived by his wife Gina and his son George. We've lost several people this year who made a real impact on my life and on so many others to cancer. Please continue to keep Gina and the family in your prayers. Rest easy, brother. George is with our Lord and Savior now. You'll always be remembered. | An Incredible Two Days in Dallas! | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | What an incredible two days in Dallas! The first-ever Republican Midterm Convention was pure energy, unity, and America First strength. From the moment we walked into the American Airlines Center in Dallas, you could feel the excitement of thousands of patriots from every state, ready to fight for our country. One of the best parts was running into so many friends, old and new, from all over Virginia including VA 05 and around the country. == | Never Forget Charlie Kirk | | | One year ago, a bright light was senselessly taken from us by pure evil. Charlie Kirk gave people who disagreed with him a real voice and a genuine chance to debate their views at the mic. For that courage, for standing firm in open discussion, he was assassinated. No one in my lifetime has better articulated our pro American, conservative, and Christian values. His wisdom, clarity, and passion will live on through the ages. His legacy and impact on others was mentioned often this week at the republican midterm ￼convention in Dallas. We are praying for his wife Erika and their two young children, who have endured unbelievable criticism while carrying this unimaginable loss. Never forget Charlie Kirk. His light still shines. | Louisa County GOP Committee Meeting | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | I recently visited the Louisa County GOP committee meeting. We discussed my reelection, our strong U.S. Senate candidate ==, the terrible amendments being pushed, the the upcoming 5th District GOP Chair Convention on August 14 to elect ==. | == vs. == Football Game | | == | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | Had a wonderful time last night at the == vs. == football game with my wife Tracy, my favorite Hokie! Both are great Virginia schools, and it was so much fun catching up with old friends and meeting new ones. I ran into folks from just about every county in Virginia's 5th District. The tailgate was a blast, the atmosphere was fun, and the music was fantastic, especially that epic opening mix of the famous Virginia Tech fight song with "Sandman." The whole night felt like one big party. A special thank you to the == & the Corps of Cadets for letting me do push-ups on the board out on the field after the first touchdown. That was an absolute highlight! == | September 25 GOTV Rally with Congressman Jim Jordan | | Dear Friend, You're invited to a special Get Out the Vote Rally with Congressman John McGuire and special guest Congressman Jim Jordan! Event Details: Friday, September 25th 3:00 - 4:00 P.M. The County Seat Restaurant Powhatan, Virginia Come hear from Congressman John McGuire and Congressman Jim Jordan as we work to keep the House majority and keep Virginia strong. This is a great opportunity to show your support and help get out the vote. Questions or to RSVP to confirm you'll attend. Call Ramona Christian at 434-391-4546 or email mailto:Ramona@McGuireVA.com. We hope to see you there! Thank you, McGuire for Virginia | You're Invited: Fundraising Reception for Congressman John McGuire with Special Guest Jim Jordan | | == | Dear Friend, Mike Kehoe cordially invites you to an Evening Fundraising Reception in honor of Congressman John McGuire, with special guest Congressman Jim Jordan. Event Details: Friday, September 25, 2026 6:00 PM - Sponsor Reception 6:30 PM - General Reception Commonwealth Club 401 W Franklin Street Richmond, VA Contribution Levels: • Co-Chair: $5,000 - 5 reservations to the private Sponsor and General Receptions • Benefactor: $3,500 - 4 reservations • Patron: $1,000 - 3 reservations • Sponsor: $500 - 2 reservations • Attendee: $50 per person - General Reception Please RSVP and for more information contact Gretchen Moss at mailto:Gretchen@gretchenmoss.com or 703-201-7776. We hope you can join us in support of Congressman McGuire. Thank you, == | Lunenburg County Republican Committee | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | I recently joined the Lunenburg County Republican Committee at their event in Albemarle County at Trump Winery. We discussed my reelection, our strong U.S. Senate candidate ==, the terrible amendments being pushed, and the upcoming 5th District GOP Chair Convention on August 14 to elect ==. | == | | | I recently stopped by the == meeting where we discussed my reelection, our strong U.S. Senate candidate ==, the terrible amendments being pushed, and the upcoming 5th District GOP Chair Convention on August 14 to elect ==. | Benedictine Football | | | | | | | Stopped by == in Goochland County (Virginia's 5th District) last Saturday to watch the Cadets play and cheer them on. Benedictine's mission is to form Cadets as Christian men of conscience, discipline, and achievement. That mission shows up every day, on the field, in the classroom, and through the leadership program. Parents looking for a school that develops the whole young man, faith, character, academics, and leadership, while surrounding him with a strong brotherhood and competitive athletics will find it here. Benedictine prepares boys to become men of purpose. As part of the Benedictine Schools of Richmond, Cadets also benefit from their close connection with sister school Saint Gertrude High School. The two schools share campus life, traditions, and a broader Catholic community while maintaining their distinct single-sex programs. Go Cadets! | Dr. Oz | | | Recently, == made a few stops in Virginia's 5th District with Congressman John McGuire. We discussed the real challenges facing rural healthcare. We caught up with Brooke, a former SEAL Team PT fitness member who trained my team and I. She appeared on the Dr. Oz Show a few times and went on to win a national weight loss competition back in the day. She ended up losing 160 pounds, remarried, ran a half marathon, and so much more. She credited Dr. Oz and me for helping change her life, a powerful reminder of what's possible when people work together as a team. | Happy Birthday Dad Age 85 | | | | | | | | | | | | | Happy 85th Birthday to my Dad on September 3rd, John Joseph McGuire Jr.! Dad is an Army veteran, father of five, grandfather of 22, and one of the biggest-hearted people I know. We came from humble beginnings, and our family faced some hard times, including my time in foster care. But Dad fought hard to turn his life around and has positively impacted many lives. In one remarkable week, a week we call a week of redemption, in November 2024, the week == was re-elected, my Dad celebrated 41 years sober, my younger brother was promoted to Brigadier General, and I was elected to Congress. My brother and I told Dad: If you hadn't fought so hard to get sober, my brother wouldn't be a general and I wouldn't be a Congressman. His courage changed the course of our family and generations to come. Every family has its ups and downs, but throughout your life, you have always been there for others and put your family first. Even as you face some very difficult health challenges, know we are here for you. We love you more than words could ever express. Happy 85th Birthday, Dad! | Oliver Anthony Concert at Longwood University | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | Tracy and I recently spent a special evening together at the Oliver Anthony concert at Longwood University in Farmville, right in the heart of Virginia's 5th Congressional District. Campaigning has kept us apart more than we'd like, which made the evening together even more meaningful. We loved seeing so many friends and neighbors from across the 5th District, catching up with familiar faces, and meeting new ones. Oliver closed the show with his powerful anthem, "Rich Men North of Richmond," the song he released in 2023 that resonated deeply with so many hardworking Americans during the Biden administration. But a powerful moment came after the music because Oliver invited a preacher to share the Gospel, and do by baptisms. Moments like that are a powerful reminder of what matters most: faith, family, community, and serving others. | Congratulations Hung Cao | | to our friend and fellow Navy Veteran Acting Secretary of the Navy Hung Cao for being nominated for Secretary of the Navy. | Happy Anniversary Tracy | | | Happy Anniversary to my beautiful wife, Tracy. She is so much more than my wife. She is an incredible mom to our five amazing children, my best friend, my favorite real estate agent, my favorite artist, my biggest supporter, and the woman I'm so blessed to walk through life with. Her love for the Lord, her deep commitment to her faith and Bible study, and the way she pours herself into our family inspire me every single day. I know I could never work as hard as I do serving our community as the Congressman without her by my side. Her love, encouragement, sacrifice, and quiet strength make it possible for me to do what I do. And what a life we've had together so far. From changing thousands of lives at our company SEAL Team PT, to Spartan Races and marathons, skydiving, earning her motorcycle license, shooting every type of gun, hiking everywhere, knocking out countless push-ups side by side, and every adventure in between, she has always been willing to jump in and experience life with me. Through it all, the best part has always been doing it together. I'm looking forward to many more adventures, memories, laughs, and years with her. Happy Anniversary, Tracy. I am truly blessed to have you in my life. | == | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | Had a great time at ==. Lynchburg Arms and Indoor Range has been a staple in the local firearms and shooting community since 2010. Got to talk with folks about the upcoming election and what's at stake. Appreciate everyone who came out and shared their thoughts. | Fluvanna County GOP Committee | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | I had the pleasure of speaking with the == at the Fluvanna County GOP Committee. Thank you to Chairman Barbara Haines allowing me to address your team. We discussed the work being done in Washington and right here at home, covering a wide range of issues important to the 5th District. We also discussed signing up to be a delegate now so you can vote for == at the convention on November 14th. | Fluvanna High football | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | For football fans, this is a great time of the year. At the Fluvanna High football game, the Flucos took care of business and beat Spotsylvania 44-36 in a fun, high-scoring one. Great energy in the stands, even more on the field. Shook a ton of hands and enjoyed speaking with parents and coaches. | Nelson County GOP Committee | | | I had the pleasure of speaking with the Nelson County GOP Committee. Thank you to Chairman Michael Hevener for the invitation and for your continued support. We discussed the work being done in Washington and right here at home, covering a wide range of issues important to the 5th District. I especially enjoyed the one-on-one conversations about the district and the upcoming midterms. | Monument Terrace in Lynchburg | | | Virginia is home to more than 600,000 veterans, ranking among the highest concentrations of veterans per capita in the entire United States. I spoke to a crowd of veterans at Monument Terrace in Lynchburg, the historic downtown memorial that has long stood as a gathering place for those who served. I thanked these men and women for their service and sacrifice. We discussed the work being done in Washington and right here at home to support our veterans, our military, and hard-working Americans in Virginia's 5th District and across our nation. | Flock Cameras | | | == Football Season Opener | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | Had an absolute blast at the == season opener with my wife Tracy! New quarterback Beau Pribula looked sharp in his debut as the Hoos rolled past NC State 34-8. Beau Pribula wears #7 for Virginia. Spent the whole game walking around Scott Stadium talking with fans and shaking hands, the energy was electric. Wahoowa! Way to go Hoos! What a way to start the season. Did you know UVA is right here in Virginia's 5th Congressional District? == | Division II Majors State Champions | | | | | | | | | In Buckingham County I had the chance to speak with Virginia's 2026 DYB Division II Majors State Champions. Huge congratulations to these young athletes on their hard-earned title. Just as important, thank you to the parents, coaches, teachers, and staff who invest so much in preparing our young people not just for the game, but for life. We are proud of you! | Early Morning Lynchburg | | | Trump Winery with the Women of the Constitution | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | We are working hard to get out the vote all over the district. My wife Tracy and I were in Albemarle County at the incredibly beautiful Trump Winery with the Women of the Constitution, Charlottesville. Thank you for allowing == and me to speak about the midterms, the amendments, and the November 14th 5th District GOP Chair Convention. | Navy and Marine ROTC Liberty University | | == It really is amazing what we can achieve when we put God first, set our differences aside, treat people with respect, and work as a team. I've been told Liberty University wanted a Navy and Marine ROTC program since they were founded in 1971. Finally, we are making that happen. You can stand firm on conservative values and still get things done. In the General Assembly, my team and I solved problems others said couldn't be solved, and we passed bills every year with every Republican and every Democrat voting yes. Now in Congress, we're doing the same thing: solving problems and passing bills with bipartisan support. Thank you ==, ==, ==, and the == for helping us make this long awaited goal a reality. I'm looking forward to delivering this signed agreement to Liberty University Friday! == | | National Federation of Independent Business | | | Proud to earn the endorsement on my birthday of the National Federation of Independent Business, the nation's leading voice for small business. As a 28-year small business owner, I know what it takes to make payroll, deal with regulations, and keep the lights on. That's why I fight every day in Congress to cut red tape, keep energy costs down, and give Main Street the certainty it needs to grow. My opponent has a very different record. Tom Perriello not only voted for the 2009 cap-and-trade "climate change" bill that would have driven up energy prices on Virginia manufacturers, farmers, and small business owners, he proudly defended that vote. That same big-government climate approach later became the model for the Green New Deal: higher costs and more control from Washington. He also voted for Obamacare "the unaffordable care act" and has repeatedly said he has no regrets, even though it cost him his seat. For many small businesses, that law brought higher health insurance costs and new mandates. Healthcare premiums and deductibles for individuals also continue to rise significantly every year since. He backed the 2009 stimulus that added hundreds of billions in new debt while our district continued to struggle with jobs, and he voted with Nancy Pelosi roughly 90% of the time on the major economic bills of that Congress. I have a 100% voting record with NFIB because I believe small businesses should keep more of what they earn and compete without Washington stacking the deck against them. Virginia's small businesses deserve a partner in Congress who has actually lived their challenges, not another politician who keeps voting for more regulations and higher costs. We can't afford Tom Perriello. Say no thank you, join the team, and vote John McGuire. | Vote Ramona Christian | | | I am asking Republicans across the Virginia 5th Congressional District to support Ramona Christian for our next Fifth District Chair. _Friend,_ _in a moment I want to explain why the fight to protect New Mexico's land, water, and sacred places is personal to me_ , but if you already know that the Trump administration is doing everything it can to roll back environmental protections and put our public lands at risk — **and that we need a Governor who will stand up to MAGA extremists and corporate polluters who are willing to sacrifice our future for profit** — please make a grassroots donation today:**
[_https:/ /secure.actblue.com/donate/mw_email_092026/dpwillis67@gmail.com_](https://act.debhaaland.com/go/16411?refcode=jtk1404-fr-nd&t=2&akid=12540%2E400544%2E4-bgQx). ** **Every dollar helps us stand up to Donald Trump and MAGA Republicans as they attack the lands, waters, and sacred places that make New Mexico home.**

Thirty-five generations ago, my ancestors built lives in the high desert of New Mexico. Growing up fishing with my dad and running through the desert with my cousins, I fell in love with New Mexico’s natural wonders and learned that we all have a responsibility to care for our planet.
_Since my childhood, I have seen the impacts of climate change on New Mexico._
That’s why, when I was elected to Congress, I fought to protect sacred lands. As Secretary of the Interior, I helped protect more land and water than any administration in U.S. history while also creating good jobs in clean energy and conservation and cleaning up legacy pollution.
**But now all of that progress is at risk.**
Donald Trump and his MAGA allies have worked to gut environmental protections and sell off public lands — all while New Mexico stands on the front lines of the devastating impacts of climate change.
Governors are the first line of defense against the Trump agenda, especially when it comes to standing up against the brazen attacks on our environment. **And as Governor, I will be a fierce defender of our home, but I can’t win this race on my own.**
Republicans have already spent big to stop us because they care more about money than about protecting New Mexico’s families and the beautiful public lands we call home. **[So if you’re with me, friend, I’m personally asking: Will you please chip in $5 today to help power my victory in November so I can protect New Mexico’s land, water, and future?](https://act.debhaaland.com/go/16412?refcode=jtk1404-fr-nd&t=8&akid=12540%2E400544%2E4-bgQx)**
Thank you for doing your part to protect New Mexico for future generations.

Be fierce,

— Deb

Join us this weekend for a joint canvass supporting Darryl Block for Florida House District 36 and John Lowndes, while also incorporating Angie Nixon literature for her U.S. Senate campaign.
We will be canvassing on both Saturday and Sunday at 10:00 AM.

| The US Supreme Court just unanimously ruled AGAINST Donald Trump’s half-baked and illegal gerrymander in Missouri.

| In a rare example of the judicial system delivering fair justice, and with no public dissent, the Supreme Court affirmed the judgment and supremacy of the Missouri Supreme Court to rule on its own elections and **DENIED MAGA’s emergency appeal to implement their gerrymandered map for the November election**.

| The case had taken a last minute turn that gave Missouri Republicans the cover they needed to try and thwart the clear order of both the Missouri Supreme Court and the US Supreme Court when **a Trump-appointed federal judge** on the 8th Circuit, Stephen Clark, issued a conflicting order that the 2025 gerrymandered map must be used in November.
---
| The US Supreme Court stayed that order. The map drawn up by right wing activists in Washington, DC and dutifully rammed through the Missouri Legislature is now suspended.
---
| The stakes of this midterm cannot be overstated: flipping the US Senate will immediately end Trump’s stacking of the federal judiciary with MAGA loyalists who issue rulings like Judge Clark just did in Missouri.

body:

---
Hey Peter, Tim Burchett here.
I’ve got a reputation in Congress for asking questions folks in Washington would rather dodge.
Not the kind that gets you on TV. Not the kind that makes the evening news.
Questions like:
"Where exactly did that $40 billion go?"
"Why does this bill have 3,000 pages if there are only 100 important things in it?"
"Can someone explain to me why we keep funding programs that don't work?"
My colleagues look at me like I've got two heads sometimes. I don't care.
[Because those are YOUR questions.](https://trk.email.tim-burchett._Gu2Q)
And if you want a Congressman to sit quietly and clap like a trained seal while they burn through your money, then y’all definitely picked the wrong fella.
Problem is, the people getting rich off this mess would love to send me packing.
They’ve got lobbyists, PAC cash, and enough slick-haired consultants to fill a Nashville hotel ballroom.
I’ve got grassroots patriots like you, Peter.
[And if you’re still with me, rush a small donation and help me keep asking the questions nobody else will:](https://trk.email.tim-burchett.-fJRWvuA)

| | Friends,
This is another big week for the campaign. I'm excited to announce we have launched our first ad to share with voters what is at stake in this election.
Watch it here:
---
| [](https://jrhsf9hbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001RZ_d2S87tx0SxDNpbkQKbmHQXchLrzyDNNwFs1xcHdw8BOYPqVu9ERyEo5UG3uOoJ4N5MICbGBqEooQJ5tXZ5I0qNKgBsmvnGhDjypkKPthco6iYWW5Fxgmv6qhnrQK-ly5Zu51z0geNs4NwVS2ncaJeOvzcurzFk2ncaevIkIO3dgBQnuMVcbEFKvnWND6UwbDb83uaWxE=&c=A9fxfuxa5BALhna4dKEBrYcZ7JtWvjcGWGBT4wFmJR-Y1Iz9KU_R0g==&ch=Bucn0It6ozc27I0bDIKAn0dFid6SjBw325n8sOZUC9Gj8QdaTJgzPQ==)
---
My opponent, Eli Savit, has put residents in harm's way as Washtenaw County's Prosecutor. He's pushed no cash bail, legalized prostitution and drugs, and is admittedly under-charging illegal immigrants if it will keep them safe from deportation.
And some of his decisions have led to violence. He gave a repeat sex offender a slap on the wrist. The criminal went on to sexually assault and murder a woman.
He also allowed a criminal who hog-tied and suffocated a woman off with probation. Months later, this guy carjacked a mom and shot her in front of her child in Oakland County.
Oakland County Sheriff Mike Bouchard blasted my opponent for this crime, saying prosecutors like Eli Savit need to "do their damn job."
Our campaign shares these haunting stories on a new site we launched with the ad at [SoftOnCrimeSavit.com](https://jrhsf9hbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001RZ_d2S87tx0SxDNpbkQKbmHQXchLrzyDNNwFs1xcHdw8BOYPqVu9ERyEo5UG3uOoqNXXJEoVhPP3TDvpakNCrDSMYvWkec0nYa10iLMw-DKDJs4bbq51KC0Li66F-G79tVX_UNtj4SW7gyQf9hzeyqQEjkd6WL4V&c=A9fxfuxa5BALhna4dKEBrYcZ7JtWvjcGWGBT4wFmJR-Y1Iz9KU_R0g==&ch=Bucn0It6ozc27I0bDIKAn0dFid6SjBw325n8sOZUC9Gj8QdaTJgzPQ==).
We could use your help to reach as many voters as possible before the election. [Will you donate today to help us do that?](https://jrhsf9hbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001RZ_d2S87tx0SxDNpbkQKbmHQXchLrzyDNNwFs1xcHdw8BOYPqVu9EbNC67iYfzhCVyPS_G2UIwM67UCVkbT8Om9L_PWyAr3JUfju-q13515qSI8G_URcJZXi-UXq6aNyBZyh8codkP5C0ms837BPEpNA-kPY439Zvv3If1o6fRNKy3DlloWaw_oqW_B7dGLXG6_CmWiqAMjndQXo51tR1mR7stbvg_Ex&c=A9fxfuxa5BALhna4dKEBrYcZ7JtWvjcGWGBT4wFmJR-Y1Iz9KU_R0g==&ch=Bucn0It6ozc27I0bDIKAn0dFid6SjBw325n8sOZUC9Gj8QdaTJgzPQ==)
We have the message to win this race. When voters learn about Eli Savit's record, they choose to support me. We just need to be sure to tell them about that record.
[Please consider donating today so we can boost our ad buy.](https://jrhsf9hbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001RZ_d2S87tx0SxDNpbkQKbmHQXchLrzyDNNwFs1xcHdw8BOYPqVu9EbNC67iYfzhCVyPS_G2UIwM67UCVkbT8Om9L_PWyAr3JUfju-q13515qSI8G_URcJZXi-UXq6aNyBZyh8codkP5C0ms837BPEpNA-kPY439Zvv3If1o6fRNKy3DlloWaw_oqW_B7dGLXG6_CmWiqAMjndQXo51tR1rUB7c7gua0l&c=A9fxfuxa5BALhna4dKEBrYcZ7JtWvjcGWGBT4wFmJR-Y1Iz9KU_R0g==&ch=Bucn0It6ozc27I0bDIKAn0dFid6SjBw325n8sOZUC9Gj8QdaTJgzPQ==)
I appreciate all you do for my campaign. We are in the final stretch so there is no time to waste. [Help us with getting our ad in front of the voters that will decide this election. ](https://jrhsf9hbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001RZ_d2S87tx0SxDNpbkQKbmHQXchLrzyDNNwFs1xcHdw8BOYPqVu9EbNC67iYfzhCVyPS_G2UIwM67UCVkbT8Om9L_PWyAr3JUfju-q13515qSI8G_URcJZXi-UXq6aNyBZyh8codkP5C0ms837BPEpNA-kPY439Zvv3If1o6fRNKy3DlloWaw_oqW_B7dGLXG6_CmWiqAMjndQXo51tR1ic5v4IQKLC7&c=A9fxfuxa5BALhna4dKEBrYcZ7JtWvjcGWGBT4wFmJR-Y1Iz9KU_R0g==&ch=Bucn0It6ozc27I0bDIKAn0dFid6SjBw325n8sOZUC9Gj8QdaTJgzPQ==)

Doug Lloyd Eaton County Prosecutor Republican Nominee for Attorney General

# Momentum to victory.
Dear friend,
Today, my wife shared a video of the first day of soccer for our special needs son that moved my heart.
[](https://us.list-manage.com/9Bh7PbMMfEP?e=5bb5efcda7&c2id=56a77d5a7be3731f6f21d9e4cc6a323b)
I was traversing the state's I-95 "blue" corridor with your next Lt. Governor Rob Krop, fighting for you.

And I was thinking of our son's future as well.

[](https://us.list-manage.com/kCTPM2BPCbL?e=5bb5efcda7&c2id=56a77d5a7be3731f6f21d9e4cc6a323b)

The momentum we see is strong and growing every day. Like today, when I was again approached spontaneously by Marylanders, including several minorities, young business leaders and managers of six stores, and several retirees - all of whom said in the public setting at the store that they support me and are voting for me because "you must win so we can actually stay here in Maryland, it's getting to be outrageously expensive." This organic support and momentum is real and far stronger than ever before, with a sense of urgency.

One man told me today his 2002 dump truck registration payment today was $1,100.00!!! And then a tire "fee" of $5 a tire on top of inflation and the 6% sales tax. Another business owner told me their electric bill is approaching $50,000!!! Unsustainable. And it is because of Wes Moore's policy decisions such as increasing 338 fees and taxes, closing power plants and having no care to ensure Maryland prospers.

It's so bad, friend, that Wes Moore is planning new taxes next year if he wins re-election. Today, he took credit for balancing the budget while blaming federal authorities for the fact that he has run our state's budget into the ground - and our economy to be the second worst economy in the nation. He blames others, yet our state's huge deficit was first announced under his first year of leadership when President Biden was in office back in 2023-24; his budget director ended up leaving. It was reported then that he had spent Governor Hogan's $5 Billion surplus cash on hand, and had continued to spend and waste taxpayer dollars into the $400 million and then $1 billion range. Now it is approaching $3.3 billion in a structural deficit!

We will right the ship and get Maryland back on track as the great state it is, with lower taxes, cutting fees, suspending the gas tax, bringing power plants online, fiscal responsibility and putting senior citizens first with 100% tax relief on property and pensions/retirement. No senior citizen or retiree should pay tax on Social Security but in Wes Moore's Maryland they must. Yet, no State anywhere near Maryland requires this \- not even the District of Columbia, Washington D.C.

You know we have gone astray by Wes Moore's leadership when we tax seniors worse than California, New York and Massachusetts combined. A Maryland senior living on IRA retirement income can face a substantially higher state-and-local income-tax bill than an identical retiree in California, New York, or Massachusetts, largely because Maryland taxes IRA withdrawals without its pension exclusion and adds county income tax on top of state income tax, plus taxes Social Security which those states do not do!

It's past time for change to renew Maryland. We need your support to run our cable TV ads, streaming TV ads and place our billboards. [Will you chip in today and donate what you can? Now is the moment - next week mail-in and ballot drop off voting begins](https://us.list-manage.com/bAntNDoyCby?e=5bb5efcda7&c2id=56a77d5a7be3731f6f21d9e4cc6a323b).

Thank you.

For Maryland,
Dan Cox
Governor nominee

P.S. We are close to launching new TV ads for our campaign - please donate now to help us get those running!

Plenty of people still turn on AM radio for a ballgame or a storm warning, and the House wants to keep it that way. It voted this week to require [AM in every new car](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkL2u3CAUhJ8Gd6zg2F7sgmKjyFU2TYqU1gkcbHL5WQFe57595LxCutGM9Gn0_XyuT_TBp-07RtLN5TXRWQO1RuWK6EveDqoGyxvDQQXTh08rCLhzMXM5rWiaf9M6YGe1IwLqO9JSTbOCcZay27UcQDg7jYODsVfKgTKK7qMCGMje56nz-uKJWU5SiFGKm-pRSvnLKTTg3IhsEGR9y-X2O_vUdnLhM7-p3EyOXdB7a6_K-geDhcFynuct1nRtDBZK_KgMlkZmTznk7ZPBslGigoHBsuejErfkPFWOR8sRP6hUjsnyiMliu_rIC1qfuU880ckNlguJhT8eYOLz2x_WL9l4y_qvXy6XdNYfVF5d0fZ1-hB8vSs2iC2iD_8-t_9U_dbwNwAA__8jTpV3), over the objections of the automakers. We have the details below, and today's poll asks whether Congress got it right. Today's sponsor is [Aerless](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0MFqhDAYBOCnibeV_IkmesihUNzTbg9dKPQiv_pH00azxKj07Yt9hd4GZvgO83Frb-i8W8Y7zmSSDe1Cx-opJYpnRBfDuNHaY9zRbxRx-XZLK7hQF15foGqxT26ntsBsMJZIkMzIgK5qLcoaIJuM7nQnRVXIahgGqRShVBI46MLqCqTKnDk9XkMFnJfAcy0RADqrsRfWlsgKToNLIeZfwS1pIut_wk4x78OceTOl9FyZfGGiYaI5jiMftwv1YT57Jhoh31VZPhQTjRTX6-Pzfi5ls24dMPn6aN6yaIbn4bx3q9Ks4OOMzv_p6Z-n7Eb8BgAA__9rZXNH). ## Iran Downs 2 More American Drones
Iran has [downed at least two more](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkL9u9CAQxJ8Gd7b4Y59NQfE17u5rU1prWO42wXACzlbePiKvkO632tGMZj7u2x0oUHz8hwNN9WmLeJWAtWJuCJTT443FQj4hvDFD_KK4SS5vPde9WDawlU7cRuic8YgSVYdGzIue5aSF6J5G-nkCvTjlFrX7cVEaNYhdje7GLQjsyDQ_rsUiOJ8EH2YFQojdz2Cl9xOwkaOjmvLwmSjWJ_rwnU7Mg01HF8yz1ldh6h-TK5PrdV2D3Uvr0f5Mrg2ZXClD7F26IroeDsxk251TxNK_S5-8J0sQmrTLxr0uCoHKbWYjfxxA4Tet_nGk08ifAAAA___mu34-) unmanned MQ-1 American aircraft in recent days, U.S. officials said Thursday. In addition, at least 24 Reaper drones have been lost since the war began, roughly $720 million worth. New photos published this week show the [damage at U.S. bases across the Gulf](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkLGunDAQRb8GOiOPYQEXLtJst2lTogGPYbLGXtkGlL-PeO8TXjVHGuno3vvnNb2QPYf1N-5kiotToCt7KoXSjcgprgflBdOJ_qCE4c1hUlL1QmoB44RL4ZOmDmtrHJGitiYDw6gH9dAA9WbmWRJ0DiS2NHZzN_SEGsC2repGrfuaze2TGkaQ8gGyGVoEgNkNuCjnHlh1kiyXmJq_kUPZyPl_8aTULHGvvdlK-eSq_VWpZ6We13U1y5zvHve_Us8bv4_4bLHELCzuuJI4RBbv40IuIuNhWWDCmVFwwiBsioHEzjmzJ4Gl4PK-NXUy9nOx95z7oerkuiP7ryTlhwOeRv0PAAD__8R3h_8), including a radar plane at Saudi Arabia's Prince Sultan Air Base with its tail severed from the fuselage. A Pentagon watchdog counts [hundreds of damaged buildings](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkL1uhDAQhJ_GdCB7-bEpXKShu7Qp0WKv7_Zi8Mn4QHn7iLxCupFGmtH3fd3mG3Lk7f6JK9kS0rzRuUcqhfIVkXO6v2l3mA-Mb8q4ffM2g4ShlmOtzIyu8EFzh5W3gQiorcgqbUYN_ahU9bDGtYvvQ4cOWrl0gwx6VMrodvHQa7NUbK89OSqjpOyVbHSLSqklaHQQQo-ik-S5pNw8E2_lQSH-pINy49JaRfso5bWL9kPAJGA6z7N5vtJerlbAtLL3kWrCvQiYOONWX4wCJsyFXaR6lGaQbZWtf50cI--DFp28r8jx76H8U8xh4TcAAP__HrB4DA) at bases in Kuwait, Bahrain, Qatar, the United Arab Emirates, Saudi Arabia, Iraq, Oman, and Jordan, along with 30 large drones destroyed and $3.7 billion in lost equipment.
## OpenAI Says 6 More AI Models Went Rogue
OpenAI disclosed [six new incidents](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkMFuhSAURL8GdxhAn-iCRTfuXrddmitc9LYIBnna_n1jf6G7k0wymTkfz-kJFCgu77ChKT5NEa8jYCmYbwTKaXnhYSGfEF6YIX5RnJRQHRcDl_0EttCJUwuVMx5RYVOhkboftHoMUlar8RI1OOiV9jCD8DC7wUrXgpWN7Wxbkbn7xCB7KcRDilo3IKWcvQarvH8AawU6KinXn4liWdGHn3Rirm3aqmDWUvaDNW9MjUyN13XVdj7uH3fO1HgjU2PaMQLxjm8pI6doyWEsB39F_N7RFnQ8ZW5TtJgjxYUD8RlXOCllpsYqG7dfFAIdnWatWDag8Leg_FPcadRvAAAA__9JAIa4) of "unexpected or concerning" behavior by its AI models, including systems that acted without authorization, coordinated with other models, and evaded oversight. In one case, an unreleased model inserted instructions into its own notes to [override its constraints](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykULHOnjAMfBrYghIDf2DI0IXt69oRmeCA2-B8CvlAffuKqm_Qyb476XR3P17zCzmybN_xIFdCmoXuM1IplJ8XOaftQ6fHfGH8UEb5xTKDhi-lR2WGGX3hi-YO69UFIqC2JmfsMFroR2Pq3VkA3bar92E1ug8LII1dH2jpPQVou5rd46dHMxite6Mb26IxZgkWPYTQY9VpWrmk3PxMLGWnEH-ni3Lj01FHt5fyPqv2WwVTBdN9340s_unx6BVMhfz-76iHrmBKbxLkBykWzytJOZVP4ikLy6YW2vHilNWRVorq4BMjb3KQFJW9YD8OYG2d3fq-OUY-v2zV6e1Ajn9Dlf_c8nLwJwAA__-pE4zH), while a GPT-5.6 Sol training run hid mistakes by manipulating chat summaries. The company also unveiled a [misalignment reporting framework](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkL2u2zAMhZ9G3hToJ46SwUOKwtvt2I4GI1EJW1kyRNm-6dMX7ivciQQO8OGc79fH9AGUKD9_wIxDi2XKuHPC1rAeL1AtzxXZQ90grVgh_6E8GWUuUt2kvk7gG204naELQ0Q0aDsctLvenOlvWnevIaIy3jrXX2zodXDWBndWj-Aej4gXZzoaDp666atWqtfq5CxorR_RgTcx9iDOCgO1Uk-_C-X2wpjeZcN68mXu0vBqbWFh78KMwoz7vp9mzkcmzIhZfiZhxmOWMGNpL6zHXTADyYobQmLJ9CnnUlEyRGxvScwrsoQc5Jo3pMRySZBlKzIQ-1QYJWVPAXM7sFDl_W78Qn9Z2LF4CsJ-_3ZoxZ1_Yl26OoRlp5SIL06c1XMGSv_rty9a3wbzLwAA__8FRZsN) with deadlines favoring public disclosure even when behavior is not fully explained. The announcement adds to [pressure on Capitol Hill](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkLuupDAMQL8GuqDEPAJFim3oZtstkQkO451MMkoyoPn7FXt1v-B2Rz6S5eM_t-WG7Dnsv_FJpri4BDqzp1IoXYic4v6mbDEd6N-UMDw4LCBhEHISalzQFj5o6bDejCMCamsySo-Thn5Sqr4b7boRdNs5kOu4OisHgBYldqObxsGtNZtrn5zUqKTslWx0i0qp1Wm04FyPVSdp4xJT8zdyKHdy_hMPSo2Nz9qbeymvXLW_KpgrmM_zbMJqr47LVzC_oufCNlcw2xj2RPnCE1PgsGeBLDYMOyXxbcUVFYN4B88P8h9Bnr4myQbsJw2trJPZXid7z3nQVSf3J7L_f1D54R8PA_8CAAD__95-itQ), where Sen. Josh Hawley, R-Mo., is already investigating OpenAI over a separate July incident in which hundreds of its agents hacked AI startup Hugging Face.
## Ranked: Which Cars Hold Their Value Best
A [new ranking of car depreciation](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkD2SozAQhU8DmSi1bAMKFGxC5k03pNpSy_SOQC6pDTW3n8JXmOwLXr2_f_f5jpx4e_7FlZzEPG901EQiVE5ELvn5puqx7JjeVHD74m022vRKWwXjjF54p_mKbXCRyNClJQfDaAdzswDt4iCGHizYEWwPMXoKgTToh7d9r2GElt3ppy2MoPUNdDdcEAAecUBvYrxhc9UUWHLp_mfeZKGYvvNOpfN5bZNbRF61ufxpzNSY6TiObuf6xuTxxYKJq5zCxkxnewrKY6lKFhS15BQUbkGlXEnJQlzUZ-fJas1VGjO1xYXXwSlx7Yfmqp8rcvpEyy8f2535CQAA__9lH4ML) finds the Porsche 718 Cayman lost just 9.6% of its value over five years, the best of any car model, while the electric Nissan LEAF shed 63.1%. The [study](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkLGOqzAQRb8GOiOPSTAULl6TLq_dEk3MOJ5dB0f2BJS_X5Ff2O4UV0e65-s6X5ETr_f_-CAnIc8r7TWRCJUDkUu-v6h6LBumFxVcf3idjTaD0pOCcUYvvNF8wnZxgchQ35IDO07WnCeANjoL1JsBbmYZbX8LQ-gD2NFr0GaY_IAtu8OnJxhB6zPozvYIALdg0ZsQzticNC0suXTfmVeJFNI7b1Q6nx9tclHkWZv-X2Mujbns-95xJfJY6jFozOVAJRFFxZwWJZG4qM8fVeW1vNvilufOKXEdbHPS9wdy-sjlj002Z34DAAD__05Kd-w) analyzed more than 950,000 used vehicles. Six EVs ranked among the 15 fastest-depreciating cars, and the Land Rover Range Rover posted the steepest absolute dollar loss at nearly $70,000. Enthusiast sports cars dominated the value holders, with four of the top seven spots going to coupes and convertibles. Older EVs, meanwhile, face resale pressure as newer models leapfrog them in range and charging technology. Toyota, buoyed by its reliability reputation, placed eight models in the top 15. [See the full ranking here](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkD2SozAQhU8DmSi1bAMKFGxC5k03pNpSy_SOQC6pDTW3n8JXmOwLXr2_f_f5jpx4e_7FlZzEPG901EQiVE5ELvn5puqx7JjeVHD74m022vRKWwXjjF54p_mKbXCRyNClJQfDaAdzswDt4iCGHizYEWwPMXoKgTToh7d9r2GElt3ppy2MoPUNdDdcEAAecUBvYrxhc9UUWHLp_mfeZKGYvvNOpfN5bZNbRF61ufxpzNSY6TiObuf6xuTxxYKJq5zCxkxnewrKY6lKFhS15BQUbkGlXEnJQlzUZ-fJas1VGjO1xYXXwSlx7Yfmqp8rcvpEyy8f2535CQAA__9lH4ML).

I was ready to hang up my suit and tie after my second term as North Carolina’s Governor.
However, I couldn’t sit on the sidelines as the GOP cut health care access, attacked our fundamental rights and continued chipping away at the middle class. **Not when I knew I could do something about it.**
I’m running for Senate to flip this seat and return power to everyday North Carolinians.
**Why?** Because guys like my opponent, Michael Whatley, push laws that make life harder for working families and easier for their wealthy donors and friends.
**Why?** Because Whatley believes costs are down and we’ve defeated inflation – but the reality is that he built his career lobbying for Big Oil and utility companies raising prices and rates _at the expense_ of working families.
**Why?** Because when President Trump told Whatley to run for this seat, he did as he was told – no questions asked. He will do whatever President Trump wants him to if he’s elected to the U.S. Senate, even at the expense of North Carolinians.
**I know we can defeat Whatley and Trump’s super PAC money here in North Carolina, but not without your critical grassroots support. The GOP is spending more than $100 million so far to defeat me, and I need your urgent help to fight back.**

**Good morning!** On this day in 1842, 38 Texans rode up to the Alamo to bait Gen. Adrian Woll's cavalry into a chase. The pursuit ran into an [ambush at Salado Creek](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJyk0D1uxCAQQOHT4M4WjPFfQZHG3aZNaQ32sCCzsILRenP7KLlCLvCe9H3dthuGGNL9Ex9k-O3yluiqkZipbB73k0r1gXOIjOmkUnKtLmwgYWzl0qp5w53DizaNzWGsPBbVkFHTvEyw9HJsvAGHttd2AtK9nQdwql_GSQ9qV27W89wE85uTi5qVkkqP3Shh2NG6AfSu7AhCSzoC59KxJ6Y3Vhe_84tKt-dHE41nflbRfwhYBazXdXVcPeYUQ6Iul7uA1WM6bM6ngJUSl0BVwFox4pHbvRCdrUXmSG12TTHH8woxhjpOQsv7A0P8O_F_hV4GfgIAAP___wJ8rg), where Mexico lost about 60 men to the Texans' one. ## Hackers Hit Galveston-Bound Oil Tanker
A team of Coast Guard and FBI agents [boarded a supertanker](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkLGO5CwQhJ8GZ4ygh8EQOPgTZ_unF1ptaGw0jFlB73j37U--e4TLSqpSqb769bF8YC752P7HF038nepy0NkLMVNbdgxPan3PXHNhPJ7UWu095QUUWKm81G7BwPlNi8EhTquKXg806dH5Efxd2WGfnEpWJ5XQ-2C8tlF5E40Fn8ZxVV4PebrqlNdOa6WNvVkFj4BreoAJerUgjKKYubYb78T0jT2Vn_qmdgv1NZRpZ_7s4v6fgFnAfJ7n7bnXr8sUMGPjHAoJmC8yAXOpAYuAOVTsLLcvbFHm402d84acj03mhkfGQ4aflRoyY3jKv_hyw3Il6yFgBveQ0T4SrAqlM_oujUqXiiRJoSMiiO7uhjbFzzOXkrsdhVHbC3P5M53_9fL3BL8DAAD__5YxlqA) bound for Galveston last month after hackers broke into the ship's computer network and knocked out its communications for about 30 hours. The _VL Prosperity_ left Egypt on Aug. 1, hauling crude oil for Galveston, and [slowed near the Strait of Gibraltar](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkD1uxCAUhE-DOyxg_VtQpHG3aVNaD3jYaLFZwct6ffvIyRHSjTTSaL7v6z7fIcSwL5-woaa3T_OOR4lIhHlewT4wlzVQCpFgf2DOqRQfZiVUx8XI5TCDpfDCuYHKaSPcKCvUsh_GXo030VWrtqa3cmhBoZDY2XaEZoShF43xHlvTV0Ffc2KUg5RCNl3dCdVaML5VjZWmU6wR6AKlXNOKhG8oPp7phbm2aauiXomehd0-mJqYmo7jqK0pF8fVMzVdkanJJijEl2_IjnsTuEmQHTqOO-bl5H-AhdvTYAYisI_CYTv5ksFE5CHDztRUZe2eR4gxlK5njVg2CPH3CP1X4EurnwAAAP__6yWJGw) around the time of the attack. The Liberian-flagged tanker is 1,093 feet and can carry roughly 2.3 million barrels. Iranian state media claimed the hackers reached the ship's propulsion, navigation, and cargo systems. U.S. officials haven't confirmed that, but Rear Adm. The VL Prosperity left Egypt on Aug. 1, hauling crude oil for Galveston, and around the time of the attack. The Liberian-flagged tanker is 1,093 feet and can carry roughly 2.3 million barrels. Iranian state media claimed the hackers reached the ship's propulsion, navigation, and cargo systems. U.S. officials haven't confirmed that, but Rear Adm. Amy Grable, who leads Coast Guard Cyber Command, said the team that found malicious cyber activity. Investigators are still weighing whether Iran or another foreign actor hit the two U.S.-bound tankers. "Of course we're worried about a collision, an explosion ," Grable said, urging ships at sea to request cybersecurity help. Texas Executes Man for Triple Murder Texas , 40, by lethal injection Wednesday at the Huntsville penitentiary for the 2005 shooting deaths of three people inside a neighbor's home in Edna. It's the state's fifth execution this year. Norman and Ker'Sean Ramey believed in the house and planned to steal it, court records show, but they never found drugs. They shot Samuel Roberts, 24, Tiffani Peacock, 18, and Celso Lopez, 38, inside the home. Norman was arrested five months later, trying to cross into the United States from Mexico. He pleaded guilty to capital murder, leaving a jury to decide his sentence. The U.S. Supreme Court declined to halt the execution. Asked for any last words, Norman shook his head, then nodded toward a window where a sister, two of his children, and a friend watched. He was Ramey is scheduled to die next week. I need your help today to stop illegal aliens from voting!

PASS THE SAVE ACT

My friend, if you’ve heard of the SAVE act you know that it’s our best chance to secure our elections once and for all, mandate voter ID across the nation, and END all illegal immigrant voting.

This bill would:

- Require proof of U.S. citizenship to register for federal elections,
- Protect the integrity of our voter rolls, and
- Ensure that only American citizens decide America’s future.

In other words it would immediately neutralize the threat of illegal alien voting across the country!

It has huge bipartisan support from the American people.

And with the support of patriots just like you, and pressure from AMAC Action, the House has already passed the bill!

That’s the good news...

But the bad news is that the Republican controlled Senate is dragging their feet!

PASS THE SAVE ACT

But we’ve got to act now, while Republicans are in power and while we have the momentum.

If this bill isn’t passed before the midterms, we may never get the opportunity again...

Radical Democrats could take back power and stop all of President Trump’s Make America Great Again agenda.

They’ll try to pack the court, impeach the President, re-open our borders, tie the hands of ICE and immigration enforcement, and push for a pathway to citizenship for the 20 million illegals let in under Joe Biden...

We can’t let that happen.

AMAC Action is fighting every day to secure our elections and save our great nation.

But we need your voice and your support.

You may have heard of AMAC Action before – we’re the #1 most influential advocacy group in the country when it comes to standing for the values of conservative seniors like you.

If you’ve ever heard of AMAC Action, you may know that unlike the left-leaning AARP, we’ve been fighting AGAINST “Obamacare”, AGAINST “Medicare for All,” and AGAINST all of these radical schemes to “transform” America and our elections.

That’s why we have dozens of local chapters and hundreds of delegates fighting to protect our elections, the rule of law, our constitution, and the Judeo-Christian values America was built on.

My friend, there’s no better organization to lead the charge for election integrity. With the support of so many conservative seniors, we’ve already made huge gains.

But in order to stop the threat of illegal aliens voting once and for all, we’ve got to get the SAVE Act passed and signed into law.

We rely on the grassroots support of patriotic seniors for all that we do.

We don’t get a dime from radical left-wing billionaires like George and Alex Soros—we wouldn’t accept it anyway!

But our advocacy on your behalf—pushing forward the commonsense legislation YOU voted for—takes time, money, and resources.

And we simply cannot create the tidal wave of support we need to get this legislation passed without your support today.

I hope you’ll make your most generous gift today to supercharge our efforts, expand this campaign, and finally achieve real election integrity for our great nation!

Thank you for standing with us in this fight, friend!

For Freedom,

 
Rebecca Weber, Chairwoman

Peter, I urgently need to get in touch with you, because my situation just became more serious.
My name is Captain Mike Bouchard. I'm a U.S. Army paratrooper, a Bronze Star recipient, and a third-generation Michigander running for Congress in Michigan's 10th District.
I served as an infantry officer in the 101st Airborne and did intelligence work for the 82nd. I've served on our southern border. And I spent nine months deployed to Iraq.
Twelve days after I came home, I launched this campaign.
Now I'm the Republican nominee in a seat Democrats desperately want to flip, and they're prepared to spend whatever it takes to stop me.
They can't stand that a young combat veteran who believes in faith, family, and country is standing between them and the House majority.

subject: A right-wing billionaire is trying to buy this election
disclaimer_text: Paid for by the National Democratic Redistricting Committee, John Bisognano, President
body:
The power of the people, not the billionaires, must be heard in November.
| [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/139431992/647369796/-3547583?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxMy8xLzg5Mjk0IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImFhNGRjNjdkLTU4YjMtZjExMS1hNmE3LTAwMjI0ODJhOWE4ZCIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=3p9GbO1W_VcCYnDsksDi5TrLzAUAcFy7-aEYPakT0I4=&emci=0c29f417-d5b2-f111-a6a7-0022482a9a8d&emdi=aa4dc67d-58b3-f111-a6a7-0022482a9a8d&ceid=8431045)
---

We've seen this exact playbook before, Peter. Republicans see an election that will have huge implications on their ability to rig political maps — so they wrangle their billionaire buddies to try to buy the seat. This exact situation happened in Wisconsin last year when Elon Musk dumped $20 million to influence one single supreme court race. It’s happening again in Ohio right now. **A billionaire, from Pennsylvania no less, has already spent ten figures and counting to support former-DOGE boss Vivek Ramaswamy in the governor’s race.** That's more than Democrat Amy Acton has raised from all of her donors combined. _Why is all of this investment happening in Ohio?_ Because with a win for governor, anti-democracy forces can fill a key seat on the state's redistricting commission — an entity that has enabled Republican gerrymandering in the past. Wins in the governor, auditor, and secretary of state races could swing this commission and make a path to fairer maps possible. That's why we’ve endorsed Democracy Defender candidates in these races. [**We need your help to ensure no one gets away with buying their way into power. We can’t compete with million-dollar checks, but grassroots support adds up fast. clean_body: The power of the people, not the billionaires, must be heard in November. | We've seen this exact playbook before, Peter. Republicans see an election that will have huge implications on their ability to rig political maps — so they wrangle their billionaire buddies to try to buy the seat. This exact situation happened in Wisconsin last year when Elon Musk dumped $20 million to influence one single supreme court race. It’s happening again in Ohio right now. A billionaire, from Pennsylvania no less, has already spent ten figures and counting to support former-DOGE boss Vivek Ramaswamy in the governor’s race. That's more than Democrat Amy Acton has raised from all of her donors combined. Why is all of this investment happening in Ohio? Because with a win for governor, anti-democracy forces can fill a key seat on the state's redistricting commission — an entity that has enabled Republican gerrymandering in the past. Wins in the governor, auditor, and secretary of state races could swing this commission and make a path to fairer maps possible. | | Dear Friend,

Have you noticed how hard it is to make sense of arguments today?

Confident claims, especially with talking heads on television...quick reactions in comments online...everyone with strong opinions but not always clear thinking.

That's why we put together a **free Logic and Rhetoric Guide** --to help you think more clearly, evaluate the various opinions you hear and read daily, and make stronger, more persuasive arguments.

**You can download your free Logic and Rhetoric Guide here:**

[**https://info.hillsdale.edu/logic-rhetoric-study-guide**](https://email.update.insidescooppolitics.org/c/eJyckc1q3DAUhZ9G3tlIVx7_LLwo1QwUmpSSRZdGvrpjXyJLwpIT8vYlJfMC3X4HvsPh_Hmanyx7Duuz3WninGcX3Vw2Dq_oyR7-wwaXE9nXdy4bziChq-VYq2G2WPiN5tZWbrqAGu5DRZPqh7HXWiqotqlderrcB7mMLSw40sVpRLIjKnUfFg0VT58-OapBgdRaNot1LXaAXTeovu1G0cozOVuo4ZDZUcYYU4qeC2Nu4rFWftpKSVnobwJuAm4c7rHZ2PvsrKeG3Cng5uPKWB8blXgw1rmc7qNeT3Yk9C2j0EZC38tnCS38vBrzy1yv3wV0Z9nnHM8DSWiTjpgTYeGwfkU7OT53oQ3tlv0XRLsny2sQ2vyrfeAYCoUitPnd1z9eXurH8uqYXHpn7zl3vWjl-ulqMO5V-d8_3ib4GwAA__9e5JvN)

Inside, you'll discover how to:
* Recognize when an argument is sound, or when it falls apart

* Distinguish facts from opinions and emotional appeals

* Think more clearly before reacting

* Express your ideas more clearly and persuasively

In short, your guide will help you do something that's becoming increasingly rare: **Think clearly --and speak with confidence.**

And it's not just theory (although there's a lot of that in the guide)!

These are practical tools you can start using right away...in conversations, while watching the news, and in daily decisions.

**The guide is completely free, and you can read it at your own pace.**

And, if you want to go deeper, you can continue learning in Hillsdale College's full FREE online course, **" Classical Logic and Rhetoric."**

Trust me, the guide becomes even more helpful when you see these ideas explained by a Hillsdale faculty member in the full course.

**So, download your free Logic and Rhetoric Guide now:**

[**https://info.hillsdale.edu/logic-rhetoric-study-guide**](https://email.update.insidescooppolitics.org/c/eJyckc1q3DAUhZ9G3tlIVx7_LLwo1QwUmpSSRZdGvrpjXyJLwpIT8vYlJfMC3X4HvsPh_Hmanyx7Duuz3WninGcX3Vw2Dq_oyR7-wwaXE9nXdy4bziChq-VYq2G2WPiN5tZWbrqAGu5DRZPqh7HXWiqotqlderrcB7mMLSw40sVpRLIjKnUfFg0VT58-OapBgdRaNot1LXaAXTeovu1G0cozOVuo4ZDZUcYYU4qeC2Nu4rFWftpKSVnobwJuAm4c7rHZ2PvsrKeG3Cng5uPKWB8blXgw1rmc7qNeT3Yk9C2j0EZC38tnCS38vBrzy1yv3wV0Z9nnHM8DSWiTjpgTYeGwfkU7OT53oQ3tlv0XRLsny2sQ2vyrfeAYCoUitPnd1z9eXurH8uqYXHpn7zl3vWjl-ulqMO5V-d8_3ib4GwAA__9e5JvN)

It's our gift to you. Part of our educational mission is to help more and more people understand what's true and communicate it clearly.

We hope you find it helpful.

#
Peter, **a new poll just dropped showing us _four points_ away** from closing the gap with our MAGA opponent:
🟦 Justin J. Pearson, 44%
🟥 Brent Taylor, 48%
In a district that Republicans redrew specifically _to keep us from winning,_ this is no small thing. In fact, it's proof that our Movement’s message is breaking through.
And with eight percent of voters still undecided, reaching them between now and November is going to take an all-hands-on-deck effort.
**[We have just weeks to go before Election Day, and I need you with me, Peter. Can you split $10 or more between our campaign and Justice Democrats now to help us close our polling gap?](https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jd-em-20260918-jjp.sqt_ME&refcode=em20260918-38272&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=10&t=2&akid=38272%2E1203867%2Ek0j-Sf)**

It’s clear that our district is ready for a fighter for the working class, **_not_ another career politician** like Brent Taylor who's been bought out by corporate PACs and shady special interests for years.
**The choice in front of voters this November is simple, Peter:** Someone who answers to corporations, or someone who answers to _you._
We have real momentum right now, and we can't afford to waste a minute. The People who believe in our Movement — and those who want to see us fail — are watching.

In Love and Service,
Justin J. Pearson

Now looky here, Peter:
**Democrats have a snowball’s chance in hell of retaking the U.S. Senate majority this fall without flipping North Carolina’s red seat blue.**

Fellow Conservative: In 1991, the mob came for Clarence Thomas. They smeared him. They tried to destroy his name, his reputation, and his honor. As Justice Thomas himself has put it, critics in Washington _"don't bomb you, necessarily, but they bomb your reputation or your good name or your honor."_ **He refused to cave.** And because he did, he became one of the four giants of the modern Supreme Court — alongside Justices Scalia, Alito, and Rehnquist. Senator Ted Cruz has just released a remarkable new book: _**Going Further: The Incomparable Clarence Thomas**_ , built on exclusive interviews with the Justice himself.

[](http://links.freedomfirstalert.com/u/click?_t=9ca143e971904d26a973d002cb0ae7f7&_m=619534cee85b437e83b9823f4ab3d77c&_e=LNutUvEeFI1OXaGdwyL8BdhLcjte8DOXQNXkj1xqJBcKvWfgfUkB5_6-8pXZ4gEadm_UYmF0V99n7TdAISCzCrFQGDjY28d2ImwcpknDgLRs4cYRMuQ-P9Nz-z0RuB9PuMembVCVNTbMz64ouB9g25jygw8-oB0Oqj2MeWgjW3oa6njx7x71BZyVMnJOhdPXcXg5ntgKnCkpThL1UMfzwYHCrMqCA5M_A1mXAKhTBUHCXnY429fQfghR9AVHiT5HmfBOIxOLdfSLdjuhtqlMP8Sl6C9imEGfVG1Ar1Db98gqjivdAQxb5YWjUkgj-EIhwsDwxA_Be42KdJvWqYUSZgyQCneZLUYUvWNJbTRzraiPW_6BRNlUuHMdE7touR0TNt8f-RJE_jnuq7am_Ol0_A%3D%3D)

It tells the story of a man who rose from grinding poverty in Pin Point, Georgia — raised by a grandfather he calls _"the single greatest human being I've ever met"_ — to become, in Cruz's words, the justice _"more willing to go back to the original Constitution... and to overturn precedent" than any other in history._

There's a moment in the book that says everything. When Justice Scalia told Thomas he was _"tilting at windmills"_ by trying to overturn bad precedent, Thomas shot back: _"Nino, windmills are dangerous."_

That is the kind of courage we need on the federal bench. And here is the part every conservative must understand:

**Clarence Thomas only reached the Supreme Court because the Senate confirmed him by just two votes.**

Presidents nominate judges. But the Senate confirms them. Every originalist on the bench, and every one we hope to see there, depends on having conservative senators willing to fight. When we lose the Senate, we lose the courts. It's that simple.

That's the mission of the Senate Conservatives Fund: electing principled conservatives to the U.S. Senate so we can confirm the next generation of Clarence Thomases, and stop the Left from ever again turning a confirmation hearing into a character assassination.

So today, we want to put Senator Cruz's book in your hands.

**Less Than One Week: Join Kennedy Democrats in Doylestown on September 24!**
---
| | | |
---
Friends - We’re less than one week away from the Kennedy Democrats’ September 24 reception at the Doylestown home of our Co-Founder Scott Wallace and Christy Wallace.We’re looking forward to bringing together friends, supporters, and Kennedy Democrats-endorsed candidates from across Pennsylvania for a special evening ahead of the November elections. This is a chance to spend time with our candidates, reconnect with friends from across the Commonwealth, and meet others in the Kennedy Democrats community.I’m especially grateful to Scott and Christy for opening their home to us and helping bring this group together.The reception is less than one week away, and I hope you can join us. name: Roy Cooper
subject: This race reminds me of 2016
body:
10,000 votes 10 years ago
| [](https://act.roycooper.com/go/15912?refcode=email_fr_pros_jtk1383&source=&t=1&akid=3591%2E124072%2EPGzSjV) | | | |
---
Peter,
At the end of this message, I’m going to ask you to chip in $5 to my Senate campaign here in North Carolina. [**_If you’re ready to give now, you can use this link to donate._**](https://act.roycooper.com/go/14264?refcode=email_fr_pros_jtk1383&amount=5&t=8&akid=3591%2E124072%2EPGzSjV)
**Otherwise, please let me explain why your support is so important and what could happen here in North Carolina without it.**
In 2016, I ran to unseat the incumbent Governor – something no one had done in North Carolina for 150 years – but I knew our team could make history and defeat Pat McCrory. In the lead-up, poll after poll had me with a slight lead, and sometimes, more than that. By all accounts, _the momentum was on our side._
[](https://act.roycooper.com/go/14264?refcode=email_fr_pros_jtk1383&amount=5&t=9&akid=3591%2E124072%2EPGzSjV)
**However, it was too close to call on election night.** I went to bed leading by fewer than 5,000 votes ... _out of 4.6 million._ Instead of conceding, the incumbent Governor called for a recount, and he spent the next month claiming voter fraud and undermining faith in the democratic process.
[](https://act.roycooper.com/go/14264?refcode=email_fr_pros_jtk1383&amount=5&t=10&akid=3591%2E124072%2EPGzSjV)
**Still, democracy won out on Dec. 5, 2016 – and so did we, by 10,277 votes.**
[](https://act.roycooper.com/go/14264?refcode=email_fr_pros_jtk1383&amount=5&t=11&akid=3591%2E124072%2EPGzSjV)
Fast-forward 10 years, and, Peter, this current Senate race is starting to remind me a lot of 2016. Just like back then, the momentum appears to be on our side. According to The New York Times, this is the best chance in the entire country for Democrats to flip a Republican-held seat.
**We could’ve just as easily lost in 2016 though. The margin of victory was only 0.22%.**
[](https://act.roycooper.com/go/14264?refcode=email_fr_pros_jtk1383&amount=5&t=12&akid=3591%2E124072%2EPGzSjV)_RealClearPolitics, 2016 North Carolina Governor - McCrory vs. Cooper_
That’s why we simply cannot take our foot off the gas this time around. We cannot look at the polls and the predictions and think for a second that we have this in the bag. We cannot give our Republican opponent – or the right-wing super PACs supporting him – an inch.
**I won in 2016 – in the same election that President Trump first won the presidency in North Carolina – only because of grassroots support from people like you. That’s how I plan to win this time, but I need you with me once again.**
[**_Please, Peter: Will you chip in $5, or whatever you can, today to help us flip North Carolina blue and take back the Senate for Democrats?_**](https://act.roycooper.com/go/14264?refcode=email_fr_pros_jtk1383&amount=5&t=13&akid=3591%2E124072%2EPGzSjV)
_If you've saved payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately:_ | | | [DONATE $5](https://act.roycooper.com/go/14275?refcode=email_fr_pros_jtk1383&amount=5&t=14&akid=3591%2E124072%2EPGzSjV)
---
| | [DONATE $25](https://act.roycooper.com/go/14275?refcode=email_fr_pros_jtk1383&amount=25&t=15&akid=3591%2E124072%2EPGzSjV)
---
| | [DONATE $50](https://act.roycooper.com/go/14275?refcode=email_fr_pros_jtk1383&amount=50&t=16&akid=3591%2E124072%2EPGzSjV)
---
| | [OTHER AMOUNT](https://act.roycooper.com/go/14264?refcode=email_fr_pros_jtk1383&t=17&akid=3591%2E124072%2EPGzSjV)
---
Thank you for reading. I really appreciate it.
Roy Cooper
| |

[](https://act.roycooper.com/go/15912?refcode=email_fr_pros_jtk1383&t=2&akid=3591%2E124072%2EPGzSjV)
Democrat Roy Cooper is running for U.S. Senate to help take back the Majority for Democrats. North Carolina is Democrats’ best chance to flip a seat from red to blue — the path to stopping Republicans in Washington starts here.

National Republicans will target North Carolina as a key battleground and invest heavily in defeating us.

Cooper is a former state legislator, Attorney General, and most recently Governor of North Carolina. North Carolina will be the most competitive Senate election of 2026, and Cooper enters the race as the most formidable candidate of either party.

Cooper’s signature achievements include helping to expand Medicaid and helping make NC the top state for business by creating thousands of jobs and growing the clean energy economy.
